closingStatement: Your farm knows more than any app. This one listens first.
ctaFinalBody: Create your account, tell us where your farm is, and see today's advice in minutes.
ctaFinalTitle: See what your farm needs today
decisionExampleBody: Rain is expected over the next two days.
featHealthBody: Take a photo of the affected plant. What to do next comes from published agricultural sources — and how sure we are is stated plainly, never hidden.
featLandBody: Every crop's plot is checked against the land you actually have — acres, bigha or hectares, whichever you use.
featLandTitle: Your land, tracked to the acre
featMarketBody: What the mandis near your farm actually traded, commodity by commodity, from government price data. Never an invented number.
featWeatherBody: Not just a forecast. "Skip irrigation today — rain is likely tomorrow", calculated for your field and your crop, with the reasoning one tap away.
featWeatherTitle: Weather that ends in a decision
featWhyBody: Every recommendation carries a "Why?" — the data and the rules behind it. Anything cached, estimated or AI-assisted is always labelled.
footerBlurb: Decision support for Indian smallholders. Sources and data ages are shown on every screen.
heroImageAlt: A farmer walking through his soybean field at dusk
heroSubtitle: Weather, mandi prices, crop health, irrigation and farm guidance — together in one place, in your language.
heroTitle: Make the right decision for your farm, at the right time.
how1Body: Your village and district are enough — no coordinates, no maps. Using your phone's location is optional.
how1Title: Tell us where your farm is
how2Body: The crop and its sowing date. Advice is calculated for your field and its growth stage, not a generic district.
how3Body: One screen shows what needs attention, what can wait, and why — in under a minute.
problemBody: Irrigate or wait? Sell now or hold? Is this leaf spot serious? The information exists — but it is scattered, often in English, and rarely about your field.
problemTitle: A farmer's biggest risk isn't hard work — it's making the wrong decision at the wrong time.
trust1: If we don't know, we say so. No invented prices, doses or forecasts.
trust2: Your photos and farm records stay private to your account.
trust3: Hindi and English, and it remembers your choice.
visualCaption: An advisor in your pocket, built around your field
